item.title: 哪儿可以下载trae历史版本

comments.body:
You can get the latest version download URL through https://api.trae.ai/icube/api/v1/native/version/trae/latest

For example, the current latest version URL I can get is:
https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/1.0.11319/darwin/Trae-darwin-x64.dmg

It contains what appears to be a build number: 11319

By continuously decrementing the buildNumber and checking each URL, any response with a 200 status code indicates a downloadable historical version.

Implementation logic:
1. Start with the latest build number
2. Decrement the build number one by one
3. Check if each corresponding download URL is accessible
4. Record all versions that return a 200 status code

This way, we can retrieve all available historical version download URLs.

Some history version as below, replace $VERSION with your needs.

download urls:

mac apple:  https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/$VERSION/darwin/Trae-darwin-arm64.dmg
mac intel:  https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/$VERSION/darwin/Trae-darwin-x64.dmg
windows:  https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/$VERSION/win32/Trae-Setup-x64.exe

script for win:

python3  script win

```python
import requests
import argparse

def find_version(platform):
    num = 12120
    while num >= 1:
        version = f"1.0.{num}"
        if platform == "mac_arm":
            url = f"https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/{version}/darwin/Trae-darwin-arm64.dmg"
        elif platform == "mac_x64":
            url = f"https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/{version}/darwin/Trae-darwin-arm64.dmg"
        elif platform == "win":
            url = f"https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/{version}/win32/Trae-Setup-x64.exe"
        else:
            print("Invalid platform. Supported platforms: mac_arm, mac_x64, win")
            return

        response = requests.head(url)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            print(f"Found version: {version}")
            #break
        num -= 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Find the latest version for a specific platform.")
    parser.add_argument("platform", choices=["mac_arm", "mac_x64", "win"], help="Platform to check: mac_arm, mac_x86, win")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    find_version(args.platform)
```

All these `$VERSION`s are not available (even the latest one, `1.0.11319`) on Windows. The URL https://lf-cdn.trae.com.cn/obj/trae-com-cn/pkg/app/releases/stable/1.0.11319/win32/Trae-Setup-x64.exe returns the following content:

```json
}
```

I think these `$VERSION`s are for Mac instead of Windows. Can you provide the `$VERSION` list for Windows? Thank you!
